propositions: Plan review PASS does not sign an attestation by default on every public route, leaving reviewed tickets without durable gate artifacts and requiring billable re-runs or manual recovery

The intended contract (sign attestation on non-blocking PASS) is stated in documentation but lacks enforcement at the CLI dispatcher and library call-path boundaries, making the default an undefended invariant

Mutating plan-review entry points must converge on signing by default with explicit `--no-sign` (CLI) and `sign=False` (library) opt-outs, while preserving guards that prevent signatures for BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and unattested-source results
An end-to-end CLI lifecycle test must prove that `rebar review-plan` without opt-out produces a claim-valid attestation and satisfies subsequent `rebar claim` without a second LLM call

PASS with signature-persistence failure must return retryable failure disposition and identify `sign-review` as the recovery path, and re-running with a current attestation must reuse it without duplicate signature events
